name: GLEIF LEI — Legal Entity Identifier reference data
description: Harvest target. Authoritative, keyless, machine-readable legal-entity reference data (Level 1 identity + Level 2 'Who Owns Whom' relationships), cross-linking to BIC, ISIN and MIC.
what_this_is: A declaration that this registry is a named harvest target and a statement of what would be measured against it. It is not a measurement. No LEI record has been measured, signed or attested by the Council of AI at this as_of.
what_this_does_not_establish: No coverage claim. The Council of AI has measured no LEI record.
No relationship with GLEIF, and no endorsement by GLEIF, is asserted or implied.
No entity named in GLEIF is a client of the Council of AI.

upstream.terms_note: GLEIF states the complete LEI data pool is searchable and accessible free of charge without registration. Redistribution terms are GLEIF's; this door restates no term and grants none.
upstream.bulk: Golden Copy and Delta files, daily cadence

levels.level_2: direct and ultimate parent relationships — who owns whom

measurement_plan.unit: one LEI record, or one Level 2 relationship edge
checks: lei_resolves — the LEI is retrievable from the GLEIF API at retrieved_at
registration_status — GLEIF's own status field, quoted verbatim, never re-graded
level2_parent_declared — a direct or ultimate parent relationship is published
cross_link_consistent — a declared BIC/ISIN/MIC resolves to the same entity
measurement_plan.grading: none. This door records whether a reference binding resolves. It issues no score, no rank and no conformity mark.

doctrine: We measure; we do not certify. Verification is free forever. UNMEASURED is first-class and is stated here rather than hidden.
